text: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to the AEBS shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by his authorised representative.
actor: vehicle manufacturer or his authorised representative
object: the application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to the AEBS

text: It shall be accompanied by the documents mentioned below in triplicate:
object: the documents mentioned below in triplicate

text: A description of the vehicle type with regard to the items mentioned in paragraph 2.4., together with a documentation package which gives access to the basic design of the AEBS and the means by which it is linked to other vehicle systems or by which it directly controls output variables. The numbers and/or symbols identifying the vehicle type shall be specified.
object: the basic design of the AEBS and the means by which it is linked to other vehicle systems or by which it directly controls output variables
conditions: together with a documentation package; The numbers and/or symbols identifying the vehicle type shall be specified

text: A vehicle representative of the vehicle type to be approved shall be submitted to the Technical Service conducting the approval tests.
object: a vehicle representative of the vehicle type to be approved
conditions: to the Technical Service conducting the approval tests

text: If the vehicle type submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation meets the requirements of paragraph 5. below, approval of that vehicle shall be granted.
conditions: If the vehicle type submitted for approval meets the requirements of paragraph 5.

text: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved; its first two digits (at present 00 corresponding to the 00 series of amendments) shall indicate the series of amendments incorporating the most recent major technical amendments made to the Regulation at the time of issue of the approval.
object: an approval number to each type approved
conditions: its first two digits shall indicate the series of amendments incorporating the most recent major technical amendments

text: The same Contracting Party shall not assign the same number to the same vehicle type equipped with another type of AEBS, or to another vehicle type.
conditions: to the same vehicle type equipped with another type of AEBS, or to another vehicle type

text: Notice of approval or of refusal or withdrawal of approval pursuant to this Regulation shall be communicated to the Contracting Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation by means of a form conforming to the model in Annex 1 and documentation supplied by the applicant being in a format not exceeding A4 (210 × 297mm), or folded to that format, and on an appropriate scale or electronic format.
object: Notice of approval or refusal or withdrawal
conditions: pursuant to this Regulation; by means of a form conforming to the model in Annex 1; documentation in a format not exceeding A4, or folded to that format; on an appropriate scale or electronic format

text: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark conforming to the model described in Annex 2.
conditions: conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form; to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation

text: A circle surrounding the Letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
conditions: followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval

text: The number of this Regulation, followed by the Letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 4.4.1. above.
object: number of this Regulation, followed by the Letter "R", a dash and the approval number
conditions: to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 4.4.1

text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.
conditions: legible and indelible

text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate.
conditions: close to or on the vehicle data plate

text: Any vehicle fitted with an AEBS complying with the definition of paragraph 2.1. above shall, when activated and operated within the prescribed speed ranges, meet the performance requirements.
conditions: when activated and operated within the prescribed speed ranges

text: of paragraphs 5.1. and paragraphs 5.3. to 5.6. of this Regulation for all vehicles.
of paragraph 5.2.1. of this Regulation for vehicles submitted to approval for Car to car scenario.
conditions: submitted to approval for Car to car scenario

text: of paragraph 5.2.2. of this Regulation for vehicles submitted to approval for Car to pedestrian scenario.
conditions: submitted to approval for Car to pedestrian scenario

text: Of paragraph 5.2.3. of this Regulation for vehicles submitted to approval for Car to bicycle scenario.
conditions: submitted to approval for Car to bicycle scenario

text: The effectiveness of AEBS shall not be adversely affected by magnetic or electrical fields. This shall be demonstrated by fulfilling the technical requirements and respecting the transitional provisions of the 05 series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 10.
conditions: by magnetic or electrical fields; demonstrated by fulfilling the technical requirements and respecting the transitional provisions of the 05 series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 10

text: When the system has detected the possibility of an imminent collision, there shall be a braking demand of at least 5.0 m/s² to the service braking system of the vehicle.
conditions: detected the possibility of an imminent collision

text: This shall be tested in accordance with paragraph 6.6. of this Regulation.
conditions: in accordance with paragraph 6.6. of this Regulation

text: At subject vehicle speeds of 40 km/h, the maximum mass is 10.00.
conditions: subject vehicle speed is 40 km/h

text: At subject vehicle speeds of 45 km/h, the maximum mass is 25.00.
conditions: subject vehicle speed is 45 km/h

text: At subject vehicle speeds of 50 km/h, the maximum mass is 30.00.
conditions: subject vehicle speed is 50 km/h

text: At subject vehicle speeds of 55 km/h, the maximum mass is 35.00.
conditions: subject vehicle speed is 55 km/h

text: At subject vehicle speeds of 60 km/h, the maximum mass is 40.00.
conditions: subject vehicle speed is 60 km/h

text: The AEBS function shall be automatically reactivated as soon as the conditions that led to the automatic deactivation are not present anymore.
conditions: as soon as the conditions that led to the automatic deactivation are not present anymore.

text: Where automatic deactivation of the AEBS function is a consequence of the driver manually switching off the ESC function of the vehicle, this deactivation of the AEBS shall require at least two deliberate actions by the driver.
object: at least two deliberate actions by the driver
conditions: Where automatic deactivation of the AEBS function is a consequence of the driver manually switching off the ESC function of the vehicle

text: A constant optical warning signal shall inform the driver that the AEBS function has been deactivated. The yellow warning signal specified in paragraph 5.5.4. below may be used for this purpose.
object: the driver that the AEBS function has been deactivated

text: During the series of test runs, the fuel level may decrease but shall never fall below 50 per cent.
conditions: During the series of test runs, the fuel level may decrease

text: If requested by the vehicle manufacturer: The vehicle can be driven a maximum of 100 km on a mixture of urban and rural roads with other traffic and roadside furniture to initialise the sensor system.
conditions: If requested; maximum of 100 km; on a mixture of urban and rural roads with other traffic and roadside furniture

text: If requested by the vehicle manufacturer: The vehicle can undergo a sequence of brake activations in order to ensure the service brake system is bedded in prior to the test.
conditions: If requested; sequence of brake activations in order to ensure the service brake system is bedded in prior to the test

text: If requested by the vehicle manufacturer: The average temperature of the service brakes on the hottest axle of the vehicle, measured inside the brake linings or on the braking path of the disc or drum, is between 65 and 100°C prior to each test run.
object: average temperature of the service brakes on the hottest axle of the vehicle
conditions: If requested; measured inside the brake linings or on the braking path of the disc or drum; prior to each test run

text: Details of the pre-test condition strategy requested by the vehicle manufacturer shall be identified and recorded in the vehicle type approval documentation.
object: Details of the pre-test condition strategy

text: The mounted tyres shall be identified and recorded in the vehicle type approval documentation.
The mounted tyres shall be identified and recorded in the vehicle type approval documentation.
conditions: in the vehicle type approval documentation

text: The target used for the vehicle detection tests shall be a regular high-volume series production passenger car of Category M1 AA saloon.
object: target used for the vehicle detection tests
conditions: a regular high-volume series production passenger car of Category M1 AA saloon

text: alternatively a "soft target" representative of such a vehicle in terms of its identification characteristics applicable to the sensor system of the AEBS under test according to ISO 19206-3:2020.
conditions: representative of such a vehicle in terms of its identification characteristics applicable to the sensor system of the AEBS under test according to ISO 19206-3:2020

text: The reference point for the location of the vehicle shall be the most rearward point on the centreline of the vehicle.
object: reference point for the location of the vehicle
conditions: the most rearward point on the centreline of the vehicle

text: The target used for the pedestrian detection tests shall be a child "articulated soft target" and be representative of the human attributes applicable to the sensor system of the AEBS under test according to ISO 19206-2:2018.
object: target used for the pedestrian detection tests
conditions: a child "articulated soft target" and representative of the human attributes applicable to the sensor system of the AEBS under test according to ISO 19206-2:2018

text: The subject vehicle and the moving target shall travel in a straight line, in the same direction, for at least two seconds prior to the functional part of the test.
actor: subject vehicle and the moving target
object: in a straight line, in the same direction
conditions: for at least two seconds prior to the functional part of the test

text: with a subject vehicle to target centreline offset of not more than 0.2m.
object: subject vehicle to target centreline offset

text: Tests shall be conducted with a vehicle travelling at speeds shown in tables below for respectively M1 and N1 categories and target travelling at 20 km/h (with  a  tolerance  of  +0/-2 km/h  for  the  target  vehicles).
object: vehicle travelling at speeds shown in tables below for respectively M1 and N1 categories and target travelling at 20 km/h
conditions: (with a tolerance of +0/-2 km/h for the target vehicles)

text: If this is deemed justified, the Technical Service may test any other speeds for subject vehicle and target vehicle within the speed range as defined in paragraph 5.2.1.3.
object: any other speeds for subject vehicle and target vehicle
conditions: if this is deemed justified; within the speed range as defined in paragraph 5.2.1.3

text: The subject vehicle shall approach the impact point with the pedestrian target in a straight line for at least two seconds prior to the functional part of the test with an anticipated subject vehicle to impact point centreline offset of not more than 0.1 m.
object: impact point with the pedestrian target
conditions: in a straight line for at least two seconds prior to the functional part of the test with an anticipated subject vehicle to impact point centreline offset of not more than 0.1 m

text: The functional part of the test shall start when the subject vehicle is travelling at a constant speed and is at a distance corresponding to a TTC of at least 4 seconds from the collision point.
conditions: when the subject vehicle is travelling at a constant speed and is at a distance corresponding to a TTC of at least 4 seconds from the collision point

text: The pedestrian target shall travel in a straight line perpendicular to the subject vehicle's direction of travel at a constant speed of 5 km/h +0/-0.4 km/h, starting not before the functional part of the test has started.
object: in a straight line perpendicular to the subject vehicle's direction of travel at a constant speed of 5 km/h +0/-0.4 km/h
conditions: starting not before the functional part of the test has started

text: The pedestrian target's positioning shall be coordinated with the subject vehicle in such a way that the impact point of the pedestrian target on the front of the subject vehicle is on the longitudinal centreline of the subject vehicle. with a tolerance of not more than 0.1 m.
conditions: so that the impact point of the pedestrian target on the front of the subject vehicle is on the longitudinal centreline of the subject vehicle with a tolerance of not more than 0.1 m

text: Tests shall be conducted with a vehicle travelling at speeds shown in tables below for respectively M1 and N1 categories.
object: with a vehicle travelling at speeds shown in tables below for respectively M1 and N1 categories

text: The technical service may test any other speeds listed in the table in paragraph 5.2.2.4. and within the prescribed speed range as defined in paragraphs 5.2.2.3.
object: any other speeds listed in the table in paragraph 5.2.2.4.
conditions: within the prescribed speed range as defined in paragraphs 5.2.2.3

text: The subject vehicle shall approach the impact point with the bicycle target in a straight line for at least two seconds prior to the functional part of the test with an anticipated subject vehicle to crankshaft of the bicycle impact point centreline offset of not more than 0.1 m.
object: impact point with the bicycle target
conditions: in a straight line for at least two seconds prior to the functional part of the test with an anticipated subject vehicle to crankshaft of the bicycle impact point centreline offset of not more than 0.1 m

text: The functional part of the test shall start when the subject vehicle is travelling at a constant speed and is at a distance corresponding to a TTC of at least 4 seconds from the collision point.
conditions: when the subject vehicle is travelling at a constant speed and is at a distance corresponding to a TTC of at least 4 seconds from the collision point

text: From the start of the functional part until the subject vehicle has avoided the collision or the subject vehicle has passed the impact point with the bicycle target there shall be no adjustment to any control of the subject vehicle by the driver other than slight adjustments to the steering control to counteract any drifting.
conditions: from the start of the functional part until the subject vehicle has avoided the collision or passed the impact point with the bicycle target

text: The test prescribed above shall be carried out with a bicycle "soft target" defined in paragraph 6.3.3.
The assessment of the impact speed shall be based on the actual contact point between the target and the vehicle, taking into account the vehicle shape.
conditions: on the actual contact point between the target and the vehicle, taking into account the vehicle shape

text: Any of the above test scenarios, where a scenario describes one test setup at one subject vehicle speed at one load condition of one category (Car to Car, Car to Pedestrian, Car to Bicycle), shall be performed two times.
conditions: one test setup at one subject vehicle speed at one load condition of one category

text: If one of the two test runs fails to meet the required performance, the test may be repeated once.
conditions: one of the two test runs fails to meet the required performance

text: A test scenario shall be accounted as passed if the required performance is met in two test runs.
conditions: required performance is met in two test runs

text: The number of failed tests runs within one category shall not exceed: (a) 10.0 per cent of the performed test runs for the Car to Car tests; (b) 10.0 per cent of the performed test runs for the Car to Pedestrian tests; and (c) 20.0 per cent of the performed test runs for the Car to Bicycle tests.
conditions: within one category

text: The Type Approval Authority shall inform the other Contracting Parties of the extension by means of the communication form which appears in Annex 1 to this Regulation.
object: the other Contracting Parties of the extension
conditions: by means of the communication form which appears in Annex 1 to this Regulation

text: It shall assign a serial number to each extension to be known as the extension number.
object: a serial number to each extension
conditions: to be known as the extension number

text: Procedures concerning conformity of production shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3)
object: those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3)

text: A vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements of paragraph 5. above
object: to conform to the type approved
conditions: by meeting the requirements of paragraph 5. above

text: The Type Approval Authority which has granted approval may at any time verify the conformity of control methods applicable to each production unit.
object: the conformity of control methods applicable to each production unit
conditions: may at any time

text: The normal frequency of such inspections shall be once every two years.
conditions: The normal frequency

text: The approval granted in respect of a vehicle type pursuant to this Regulation may be withdrawn if the requirements laid down in paragraph 8, above are not complied with.
object: the approval granted in respect of a vehicle type
conditions: if the requirements laid down in paragraph 8, above are not complied with

text: If a Contracting Party withdraws an approval it had previously granted, it shall forthwith so notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation by sending them a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1 to this Regulation.
conditions: if it withdraws an approval it had previously granted

object: approval to car to car scenario

text: Approval to car to pedestrian scenario granted/refused/extended/withdrawn: 2
object: approval to car to pedestrian scenario

text: A function which is over-ridden becomes part of the complex system, as well as any overriding system/function within the scope of this Regulation.
object: the complex system, as well as any overriding system/function
conditions: within the scope of this Regulation

text: The transmission links to and from overriding systems/function outside of the scope of this Regulation shall also be included.
object: the transmission links to and from overriding systems/function
conditions: outside of the scope of this Regulation

text: Additional material and analysis data of paragraph 3.4.4. which shall be retained by the manufacturer, but made open for inspection at the time of type approval.
object: material and analysis data of paragraph 3.4.4
conditions: made open for inspection at the time of type approval

text: The manufacturer shall ensure that this material and analysis data remains available for a period of 10 years counted from the time when production of the vehicle is definitely discontinued.
conditions: remains available for a period of 10 years counted from the time when production of the vehicle is definitely discontinued

conditions: gives a simple explanation of all the control functions of 'The System' and the methods employed to achieve the objectives, including a statement of the mechanism(s) by which control is exercised

action: be identified and a further description of the changed rationale of the function's operation provided
object: any described function that can be over-ridden

text: A list of all input and sensed variables shall be provided and the working range of these defined.
action: be provided and the working range of these defined
object: list of all input and sensed variables

text: The Technical Service may perform or may require to perform tests as specified in paragraph 4. to verify the safety concept.
action: perform or may require to perform
conditions: as specified in paragraph 4. to verify the safety concept

text: This documentation shall itemize the parameters being monitored and shall set out, for each fault condition of the type defined in paragraph 3.4.4. of this annex, the warning signal to be given to the driver and/or to service/technical inspection personnel.
conditions: for each fault condition of the type defined in paragraph 3.4.4.

text: This documentation shall set out, for each fault condition of the type defined in paragraph 3.4.4. of this annex, the warning signal to be given to the driver and/or to service/technical inspection personnel.
conditions: for each fault condition of the type defined in paragraph 3.4.4.

text: The functional operation of "The System", as laid out in the documents required in paragraph 3., shall be tested as follows:
conditions: as laid out in the documents required in paragraph 3.

conditions: under non-fault conditions by testing a number of selected functions from those declared by the manufacturer in paragraph 3.2.

object: scenarios whereby a declared function is overridden
conditions: For complex electronic systems

text: Verification of the safety concept of paragraph 3.4.
conditions: null
